Next, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac) to determine the nature of roots. Then apply the quadratic formula: x = (-b ± √discriminant) / 2a. Finally, simplify each solution and verify by substituting back into the original equation.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves standardizing your data, computing the covariance matrix, finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors, then sorting them by magnitude. The largest eigenvectors become your principal components. Don't be anxious; it's just linear algebra applied to dimensionality reduction. Think of it as finding the most important directions in your data space.
